findings.summary:
Loading state is a bare '

جارٍ تحميل الهيكل…

' instead of the shared LoadingScreen/skeleton pattern used across the app.
findings.fix: Replace the plain paragraph with '<LoadingScreen label="جارٍ تحميل الهيكل…" />' (already imported elsewhere) so loading uses the branded spinner + aria-busy pattern consistently.

findings.summary: The bespoke 'Summary' component reimplements a metric tile with 'card p-5' instead of reusing the shared MetricCard primitive used by 14 other management pages.
findings.fix: Delete the Summary function and render '<MetricCard label={...} value={...} icon={...} />' for each of the 5 tiles so metrics match the standard metric-card styling, icon chip, and typography.

findings.summary: Department search is a lone bespoke '<input className="input max-w-xs">' with no result count, no clear button, and no FilterBar wrapper — inconsistent with the app's FilterBar UX.
findings.fix: Wrap the departments search in '<FilterBar searchValue={filter} onSearchChange={setFilter} searchPlaceholder="بحث بالاسم أو الكود" resultText={`${departments.length} إدارة`} isDirty={!!filter} onClear={() => setFilter('')} />' to gain result count, clear-all, and aria-label.

findings.summary: Department and position data tables use raw '<table>' markup without the shared '.data-table' class, so they lack the standard table styling and scope semantics.
findings.fix: Add 'className="data-table"' to both tables (or wrap in the app's data-table pattern) and add 'scope="col"' to the '<th>' cells for consistent styling and header semantics.

findings.summary: Both tables render nothing when the filtered/position list is empty — no EmptyState is shown for zero departments or zero positions.
findings.fix: When 'departments.length === 0' (or 'data.positions.length === 0') render '<EmptyState title="لا توجد إدارات" description="..." />' instead of an empty '<tbody>', matching the app's empty pattern.

findings.summary: The shared Select helper renders a '<select>' associated only via a visible '<span>' label (not a real label/for or aria-label), and the toggle checkbox (line 103) similarly lacks an explicit accessible name.
findings.fix: Either wrap the control so the '<label>' element programmatically associates with the '<select>'/'<input>' (it currently does via nesting, so add 'aria-label={label}' on the select as a safeguard) to ensure each control has a discoverable accessible name.

findings.summary: Summary tile icon uses 'text-brand' utility while the rest of the codebase colors icons via design-token vars (e.g. metric-icon chip / --brand-primary).
findings.fix: Adopting MetricCard (finding above) removes this; otherwise color the icon with 'text-[var(--brand-primary)]' to stay on tokens rather than a bespoke utility.

findings.summary: Summary grid uses 'xl:grid-cols-5' for 5 tiles, which on medium widths (sm:grid-cols-2) leaves an orphaned single tile with uneven wrapping.
findings.fix: Add an intermediate breakpoint (e.g. 'lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-5') so the 5 tiles wrap evenly across viewport sizes.
